title: Case 030: Discovery Date Missing from Leak Claim
initial_request: I have an open leak claim for 130 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 3ZZ. Could you check the claim record and help me provide when I first noticed the ceiling stain?
overview: Alice Chen contacted Tom at Cresswell Cover about her already-open leak claim. Northmere Mutual asked for the date the stain was first noticed; Tom sought clarification from Alice, who said she first saw it on 6 May and could not determine when the leak began. Tom passed that discovery date to the insurer, which confirmed the claim record had been supplemented.

next_action.summary: Tom obtained Alice's first-observed date and sent it to Northmere Mutual for addition to the open claim; the record has now been supplemented.

outcome: The claim record was supplemented with the date Alice first noticed the stain; no decision on cover or payment was made.

events.body: I have an open leak claim for 130 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 3ZZ. The claim entry describes a ceiling stain, but I have not been asked when I first noticed it; could you check what information is still needed?

Please provide the date the policyholder first noticed the staining for open claim CLM-030. The date the damage was discovered is needed for the claim record; it should not be treated as the date the leak necessarily began.

Northmere Mutual has asked when you first noticed the ceiling stain for claim CLM-030. Please tell me the day you first saw it, even if you cannot tell when the leak started; if water is still coming through, let me know so safe containment can be arranged.
I first noticed the stain on the kitchen ceiling on 6 May. I do not know when the leak itself began, and I am giving 6 May only as the date I first saw the damage.

For open claim CLM-030, Alice Chen confirms that she first noticed the ceiling stain at 130 Beech Walk, Brackenford, ZZ4 3ZZ, on 6 May. This is the discovery date she can confirm, not an asserted start date for the leak.
We have added 6 May as the date the policyholder first noticed the staining on claim CLM-030. The claim record is supplemented; this confirmation is not a decision on cover or payment.
